description: Source code for the ProgramTable class managing ELF program headers and segments in an ELF loader implementation.

classes.name: ProgramTable
classes.description: Manages ELF program headers, segments, memory mapping, and related info for ELF loading.

methods.name: LoadProgramHeader
methods.description: Loads and memory maps the ELF program header table from a file.

methods.name: LoadSegments
methods.description: Loads ELF segments into memory, handling memory mapping and protections.

methods.name: GetLoadMemorySize
methods.description: Calculates total memory size needed for loadable segments.

methods.name: GetDynamicSection
methods.description: Retrieves the dynamic section from ELF segments.

methods.name: AdjustMemoryProtectionOfReadOnlySegments
methods.description: Adjusts memory protections for read-only segments.

methods.name: ReserveLoadMemory
methods.description: Reserves address space for ELF load segments.

methods.name: PublishEvergreenInfo
methods.description: Publishes ELF load info to Evergreen system.

methods.name: GetBaseMemoryAddress
methods.description: Returns the base address of loaded ELF segments.
